# Public HTML captures for local visual tests

Captured from the four public essays on deepankerseth.com during the October 2026 redesign. Each JSON contains only its public URL, title, essay HTML, and plain text. HTML preserves the existing article exactly. `text` is not original Markdown.

These are disposable browser-test inputs, never a production import or backup. Do not edit and publish these fixture rows as if their `content` field were original Markdown. Use the real database export for production migration. scripts/redesign-fixture.mjs verifies source URLs and selected passages and refuses existing persistence directories.
